memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then God said, "This is the sign of the covenant I am making between me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come: I have set my rainbow in the clouds, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and the earth." - Gen 9:12-13 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God makes a covenant never again to destroy the earth by flood, and He gives a visible sign to seal it: the rainbow. Every time the storm clouds gather and the rain falls, the rainbow appears as God's own promise arching across the sky - a reminder that His mercy holds and His word stands. What a gracious God, who gives us a sign we can see to reassure our doubting hearts.

Notice something beautiful about the rainbow. It appears precisely when the rain is falling - in the very moment when fear might rise. Right when the storm reminds us of judgement, God's sign of mercy shines through. His promise is most visible in the middle of the clouds, not only after they clear.

There is comfort here for stormy times. When the skies of our lives darken, God has given us signs of His faithful promise to hold on to. He binds Himself by covenant, and He keeps His word. The rainbow tells us that mercy triumphs, that God remembers His promises, that the storm will not have the final say.

This covenant with all creation points forward to the greater covenant sealed in Christ. Just as the rainbow assures us God will not flood the earth again, the cross assures us that all who are in Christ will never face condemnation (Rom 8:1). God has given His people signs and promises to anchor our hope. Look up at the rainbow and remember: God keeps His word.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What promises of God are you holding on to in your current storms?
- How does it comfort you that God gives visible signs to reassure His people?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Faithful God, thank You for the rainbow and for every promise You give to reassure my heart. When storms gather, help me remember that You always keep Your word, and thank You for the covenant sealed in Christ.
